key_insight: Reference-free PINNs resolve strong kinetic shock waves with high accuracy, but higher-order moments reveal errors that bulk flow fields can miss.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a promising route to predicting strongly nonequilibrium gas flows relevant to high-speed aerospace applications.
method: Learn a signed correction to an end-state Maxwellian mixture with exact inflow conditions.
Minimise kinetic residuals in three norms plus conservation terms, without reference data in the loss.
Combine Adam, self-scaled quasi-Newton optimisation and Mach-number continuation.
evidence_signal: Across eight fields, the largest relative L2 difference from DSMC for hard-sphere Boltzmann shocks was 0.19% at Mach 8 and 0.34% at Mach 10.
watch_item: High-Mach BGK fourth-order moments required loss reweighting and longer optimisation; their errors remained up to 7.1% at Mach 100.
paper_title: Physics-informed neural networks for strong normal shocks in kinetic relaxation models and the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
